messages.content: padhda padhdai man aru tira janchha, k garu?

yo dherai jana lai hunchha, tapai matra haina. phone arko kotha ma rakhera 25 minet matra padhnus, ani 5 minet aaram. suru ma 25 minet pani lamo lagna sakchha, tyasaile 15 minet bata suru garda pani hunchha. padhna agadi 'aaja yo chapter ko 3 ta prashna sakchhu' jasto sano lakshya lekhnus, man lai kaha jaane thaha hunchha.
how do i remember what i study? i read but forget next day

Reading alone is weak for memory. After each page, close the book and try to say or write the main points from memory, then check what you missed. Review the same topic again after 1 day, then 3 days, then a week. That small effort of recalling is what makes it stick.
math ma kamjor chhu, formula yaad hunna yaar

formula ratnu bhanda kina kaam garchha bujhna khojnus. euta formula lina, 2-3 sajilo udaharan afai solve garnus, ani tyo formula ek chhuttai copy ma lekhnus. har din 10 minet tyo copy padhnus. ra galti bhayeka prashna pheri solve garnus, galti nai sabai bhanda ramro shikshak ho.
group study ramro ki eklai padhne?

duitai ko aafnai faida chha. naya chapter bujhna eklai shanta thau ma padhnu ramro. ani bujhisakeko kura dohoryauna ra prashna solve garna group ramro, kinaki sathi lai bujhaunda afno pani pakka hunchha. tara group gaff ma badalinchha bhane samaya tokera basnus.
bihana padhne ki raati? ma raati 2 baje samma padhchhu

raati 2 baje samma padhda nidra kam hunchha, ani bholi padheko kura dimag ma ramrari basdaina. nidra ma nai dimag le padheko kura save garchha. sakchhau bhane 11 baje sutne ra bihana 6 baje uthera 1-2 ghanta padhne try gara. raati ko samaya chai halka revision ko lagi rakha.
SEE aauna 2 mahina matra baki chha, kun subject bata suru garne? science ra math kamjor chha

2 mahina thik samaya ho, aatinu pardaina. kamjor subject lai bihana ko taja samaya dinus: ek din math, arko din science. ani beluka sajilo subject ko revision. har haptama ek palta purano question paper samaya rakhera solve garnus, kun chapter ma ank gumchha thaha hunchha. ani tyo chapter lai priority dinus.
bholi exam chha, kei aaudaina jasto lagirako chha, dar lagyo

exam agadi ko raati yesto lagnu ekdam samanya ho, padheko kura harayeko haina. aaja naya chapter nasuru garnus, padheko kura ko main point matra herda pugchha. ani 7-8 ghanta sutnus, nidra le yaad shakti farkaunchha. exam hall ma pahila sajilo prashna gara, confidence aafai aauchha.
result aauna lagyo, fail bhayo bhane ghar ma k bhanlan bhanne tension

result kurera basnu sabai bhanda garo samaya ho, kinaki hamro haat ma kehi hudaina. tara euta kura sochnus: jasto result aaye pani tyo euta exam ko ank ho, tapai ko pura jiwan haina. tension dherai bhaye ghar ma kunai ek jana sanga ahile nai kura garnus, dherai jaso parivar le soche bhanda badhi bujhchha.
exam hall ma gayepachhi blank hunchhu, sab birsinchhu

tyo dar le hune ho, padhai ko kami le haina. hall ma basepachhi 1 minet gahiro saas linus: 4 second bhitra, 4 second bahira. ani pura question paper padhnus ra sabai bhanda sajilo prashna bata suru garnus. euta prashna lekhepachhi dimag 'on' hunchha. ghar ma pani ghadi rakhera mock test diyo bhane hall ko dar ghatdai janchha.
mero sathi haru le sab padhisake re, ma chai adha matra

sathi le 'sab padhisake' bhaneko dherai jaso dar ma bhaneko hunchha, sadhai sachchai hudaina. tulana garda tapai ko samaya ma dar matra badhchha. baki adha ma bata sabai bhanda dherai ank aaune chapter chhannus ra tyo pahila sakaunus. adha ramro sanga bujheko pura halka padheko bhanda dherai ramro ho.
I failed my board exam by 3 marks. I feel so stupid.

I'm really sorry, missing by 3 marks hurts more than missing by a lot. But it doesn't mean you're stupid; it means you were very close. Check if re-totaling or a supplementary exam is possible, because 3 marks can sometimes change. And give yourself a few days to feel bad before planning, that's allowed.
kei garna man lagdaina, din bhari phone matra chalaunchhu

yo dherai jana ko samasya ho, phone yestai banaiyeko hunchha ki chhodna gaaro hoss. ek kaam garnus: bihana uthne bittikai 30 minet phone nahernus. ani din ma euta matra sano kaam pura garnus, jastai kotha milaune. sano kaam sakepachhi arko garna man aafai aauchha.
gym suru gareko 1 hapta bhayo, aba jana man lagdaina

1 hapta pura garnu bhayo, tyo pani sano kura haina! suru ko josh ghatepachhi nai baani banne samaya ho. ahile lakshya sano banaunus: 'gym gayera 20 minet matra garchhu' bhannus. pugepachhi dherai jaso ma badhi nai garinchha. ani kun din gaye calendar ma chinha lagaunus, chain todna man lagdaina.
sabai le malai bhanda ramro garirako chhan jasto lagchha

social media ma arko ko ramro din matra dekhinchha, garo din dekhindaina. tyasaile tulana sadhai asamaan hunchha. afno 6 mahina agadi ko afu sanga tulana garnus: k naya sikyau, k sudhriyo? tyo sano progress nai tapai ko sachcha naap ho.
mero sapana doctor banne ho tara entrance garo chha re

garo chha bhanne kura sahi ho, tara asambhav haina, har barsa dherai jana pass hunchhan. suru ma syllabus herera kun bishaya ma kati ank chha thaha paunus. har din nirantar padhai ra har hapta ek model test, yahi formula le kaam garchha. ek din ko josh bhanda dherai mahina ko niyamit padhai le jitchha.
i keep procrastinating on my project, deadline is friday

Big tasks feel scary, so the brain avoids them. Break the project into tiny pieces and write them down, like 'make the outline' or 'write the intro'. Today, do just the first piece for 20 minutes. Starting is the hardest part; once you begin, it usually keeps going. Friday is still reachable if you start today.
raati 1 baje samma nidra lagdaina, phone chalairahanchhu

phone ko ujyalo le dimag lai 'ajhai din chha' bhanchha, tyasaile nidra dhilo aauchha. sutnu bhanda 30 minet agadi phone charge ma tadha rakhnus. tyo samaya ma halka kitab padhnus ki shanta sangit sunnus. ani har din ekai samaya ma uthnus, bidaa ko din pani, dhilo uthda raati pheri nidra laagdaina.
din ma kati ghanta sutnu parchha?
dherai jaso thulo manchhe lai 7 dekhi 9 ghanta chahinchha. kishor umer ka bidyarthi lai ajha badhi, 8 dekhi 10 ghanta. ghanta matra haina, niyamit samaya ma sutnu pani mahatwapurna chha.
dinma sutda ramro ki naramro?

chhoto nidra, 20-30 minet ko, thakai hatauna ramro hunchha. tara 1 ghanta bhanda lamo ki beluka 4 baje pachhi sutyo bhane raati nidra bigranchha. dupahar 1-3 baje bich chhoto sutnu sabai bhanda thik ho.
mero best friend le malai ignore garna thalyo, kina hola?

kina bhanne pakka thaha nabhai dherai kura dimag ma aauchha, tyo dukhad hunchha. hunasakchha usko afnai kehi samasya chha, ki kehi galatfahami bhayo. sidhai tara shanta bhayera sodhnus: 'aajkal hamro kura kam bhayo, kehi bhayo ki?' aaropan nagarera sodheko prashna le dherai jaso dhoka kholchha.
naya school ma sathi chhaina, kasari banaune?

naya thau ma suru ma eklo lagnu swabhabik ho, sabai lai lagchha. chhew ma basne manchhe lai sano prashna sodhnus, jastai 'homework k thiyo?'. club, khel ki kunai activity ma bhag linus, ekai kura man parne sanga sathi banna sajilo hunchha. dherai jaso afu jastai arko pani kohi sathi khojdai hunchha.
sathi le paisa sapat liyeko 3 mahina bhayo, firta gardaina

yo asajilo awastha ho, kinaki paisa ra sathi duitai mahatwapurna chhan. ris nagari sidhai bhannus: 'malai tyo 3 mahina agadi ko paisa chahiyeko thiyo, kahile sambhav hunchha?'. ek palta ma dina garo bhaye kista ma dina bhannus. ani aagadi sapat dinu agadi 'firta naaye pani thik chha' bhanne rakam matra dinus.
sathi sanga jhagada bhayo, maile nai galti gare jasto lagchha

afno galti dekhnu sajilo kura haina, tyo nai ramro suruwat ho. sathi lai chhoto message ki pratyaksha bhannus: 'maile tyo din tyasto bhannu hunthena, sorry'. bahana nathapi sidha sorry bhanda dherai asar garchha. uslai sochna samaya chahina sakchha, tyo pani swikarnus.
is it okay to have just one or two close friends?

Completely okay. Many people are happiest with one or two friends they can truly trust. What matters is how good the friendship is, not how many friends you have. If those friendships feel warm and honest, you're doing well.
mero talab 15000 chha, 20 percent bachaune ho bhane mahina ma kati ra barsa ma kati hunchha?
mahina ma 3000 rupiya ra barsa ma 36000 rupiya bachchha. talab aaune bittikai 3000 chhuttai khata ma halnus, baki ma kharcha milaunus.
din ko 50 rupiya bachaye 1 barsa ma kati hunchha? mahina 30 din manera
mahina ma 1500 ra barsa ma 18000 rupiya hunchha. sano rakam pani niyamit bhaye thulo banchha!
messages.steps: 50 x 30 = 1500 mahina ma. 1500 x 12 = 18000 barsa ma.

messages.content: paisa haat ma aaune bittikai sakinchha, k garne?

sabai bhanda kaam garne upaya: paisa aaune bittikai bachat pahila chhuttyaune, kharcha pachhi. ani ek hapta samma sabai kharcha lekhnus, kun thau ma paisa chuhirahechha dekhinchha. dherai lai chiya-nasta, online shopping ra mobile data ma ascharya lagne kharcha dekhinchha.
ma student ho, pocket money 2000 matra aauchha, bachat sambhav chha?

sambhav chha! 2000 ko 10 percent, mane 200 rupiya, mahina ko suru mai alag rakhnus. 200 sano lagla, tara 1 barsa ma 2400 hunchha. rakam bhanda baani mahatwapurna ho, yo baani thulo bhayepachhi dherai kaam lagchha.
coding sikna man chha tara kaha bata suru garne thaha chhaina

python bata suru garnu sajilo hunchha, yasko syntax angreji jastai padhna milchha. pahila variable, if-else, loop ra function sikna. ani sano project banaunus: calculator, guessing game, ki todo list. har din 30 minet pani niyamit garda 3 mahina ma thulo farak dekhinchha.
code lekhda error aairakhchha, frustrate bhaye

error aaunu coding ko normal bhag ho, ramro programmer lai pani din bhari error aauchha. error message dhyan le padhnus, line number ra error ko naam herera google garnus. ani code sano bhag ma test garnus, kun line ma bigriyo thaha hunchha. har error solve garda tapai ek kadam aghi badhnu hunchha.
web development ki android, kun sikne?

duitai ramro bato ho, tapai lai k banauna man chha tyasma bhar parchha. website banauna ra chhito result herna man chha bhane HTML, CSS, JavaScript bata web. phone app man parchha bhane kotlin ra jetpack compose sanga android. nikit pani android ra web duitai ma kaam garnu hunchha, ek pakka bhayepachhi arko sajilo hunchha.
tutorial herda bujhchhu tara afai lekhna sakdina

yaslai 'tutorial hell' bhanchhan, dherai jana phaschhan. tutorial hereko kura bina hernai afai pheri lekhna khojnus. ani tutorial ma nabhayeko sano feature thapnus, jastai calculator ma history button. afai sochda nai sachchai sikinchha, garo lagnu nai sikdai chhu bhanne sanket ho.
aaja kina ho kunni ekdam udas lagirako chha

kahile kahi kina bhanne thaha nabhai pani man bhari hunchha, tyo pani thik ho. afulai ali naram hunus aaja. pani piunus, ali bahira hidnus, ani man parne kura gari aaram garnus. bhanna man chha bhane ma yahi chhu, k k bhayo aaja?
mero hajurba bitnu bhayo last week, padhna man lagdaina

tapai ko hajurba bitnu bhayeko sunera dherai dukha lagyo. ek hapta matra bhayo, yati chhito sab normal hunu pardaina. shok ma dhyan nalagnu ekdam swabhabik ho. sakchhau bhane teacher lai bhannus, ani hajurba ko yaad parivar sanga bandnus. bistarai padhai ma pani man farkinchha.
kohi pani malai bujhdaina, sabai lai bojh jasto lagchha afu

yasto mahasus garnu dherai garo ho, ra yo bhannu bhayeko ma khusi chhu. tapai bojh hunuhunna, tapai ko bhawana mahatwapurna chha. tapai le bharosa garne kohi ek jana, sathi, parivar ki teacher, sanga yo kura bhannus. ra kahile kai afulai hani garne bichar aauchha bhane ahile nai najik ko manchhe ki helpline sanga kura garnus, tapai eklo hunuhunna.
exam ko tayari kasari garne? 3 hapta chha
3 hapta ramro samaya ho. pahila sabai subject ko list banaunus ra kun kamjor chha chinha lagaunus. ani har din 2 subject: bihana kamjor, beluka sajilo.
mero 6 subject chha, english sajilo ani account garo

6 subject ra 3 hapta (21 din) bhaye har subject le 3-4 din paauchha. account lai sabai bhanda badhi, kamsekam 5 din dinus, ra english lai 2 din bhaye pugchha. pachhillo 3 din sabai subject ko revision ra purano prashna ko lagi rakhnus.
account ma k padhne pahila?

account ma pahila journal entry ra ledger pakka garnus, kinaki baki chapter tyasmai adharit chhan. ani trial balance ra final account. har din 5-6 prashna afai solve garnus, padhera matra account aaudaina.
malai paisa bachaunu chha, talab 12000 ho
ramro nirnaya! pahila mahina ko kharcha kati kati huncha bhannus, ani hisab milaaula.
kotha bhada 4000, khana 3000, transport 2500, phone ra aru 1500
tapai ko jamma kharcha 11000 hunchha, tyasaile mahina ma 1000 rupiya bachchha. suru ma tyo 1000 talab aaune bittikai chhuttyaunus. ani transport ra phone ma alikati ghataune thau chha ki hernus.
din ma 100 rupiya bachaye bhane 25000 ko phone kinna kati mahina lagchha? mahina 30 din
9 mahina lagchha. 8 mahina ma 24000 hunchha, ajhai 1000 nagnu parchha, tyasaile 9 au mahina ma pugchha.
messages.steps: 100 x 30 = 3000 mahina ma. 3000 x 8 = 24000, 25000 bhanda kam. 3000 x 9 = 27000, pugchha. tyasaile 9 mahina.

messages.content: ani din ma 80 matra bachaye?
din ma 80 bhaye mahina ma 2400 bachchha, ani 11 mahina lagchha. 10 mahina ma 24000 matra hunchha, 25000 pugdaina.
messages.steps: 80 x 30 = 2400. 2400 x 10 = 24000, pugdaina. 2400 x 11 = 26400, pugchha. tyasaile 11 mahina.

messages.content: i want to learn coding but i only have my phone
You can still start! Apps like Pydroid 3 (Android) let you write and run Python on your phone. Practice basics daily, and solve small problems on sites made for beginners.
how long per day should i practice?
Even 30 minutes a day is enough if you do it every day. Consistency beats long weekend sessions. On your phone, short focused sessions also work better because typing code is slower there.
ok and what should my first project be?

A number guessing game is a great first project on a phone: the program picks a random number and you guess with hints like 'too high' or 'too low'. It uses variables, input, if-else and loops, which are exactly the basics you need.
mero sathi Ramesh le malai birthday party ma bolayena
ohh, yasle chot lagnu swabhabik ho. tapai ra Ramesh kati najik ko sathi ho?
class 5 dekhi sangai padhya, best friend jasto

class 5 dekhi ko sathi bhayera ajha naramro lagyo hola. tara bolauna birseko ki ghar ma thorai manchhe matra bolauna paayeko pani hunasakchha. Ramesh lai sidhai sodhnus, 'party ko kura sunera ali naramro lagyo, k bhayeko thiyo?'. purano sathi sanga khulera bolna sakinchha.
sodhe, usle bhanyo ama le 5 jana matra bolaunu bhanya thiyo re

la, tyasaile bhayeko rahechha, Ramesh le jaanijaani gareko hoina. sodhnu bhayeko ramro bhayo, natra man ma kura basirahanthyo. aba ek din tapai duijana matra bahira ghumna janus, sathi pheri najik hunchha.
ma raati 3 baje sutchhu, bihana class miss hunchha
3 baje sutda bihana uthna garo hunu swabhabik ho. ek chhoti ma 11 baje sutna khojda kaam gardaina, sharir le manna. har 2-3 din ma 30 minet agadi sutnus: 2:30, ani 2 baje, yasari.
yesari garda 11 baje pugna kati din lagchha?
3 baje bata 11 baje samma 4 ghanta ho, mane 8 palta 30 minet sarnu parchha. har 3 din ma 30 minet sarda 24 din lagchha. ali chhito chahiyo bhane har 2 din ma sarda 16 din.
messages.steps: 3 baje dekhi 11 baje (agillo raat) = 4 ghanta = 240 minet. 240 / 30 = 8 palta. 8 x 3 = 24 din. 8 x 2 = 16 din.

messages.content: udas chhu, girlfriend sanga breakup bhayo
sunera naramro lagyo. breakup pachhi man khali jasto lagnu dherai swabhabik ho. kati samaya sangai thiyau?
2 barsa. aba k garne thaha chhaina

2 barsa sanga bitayeko samaya ko yaad sajilai jaadaina, tyasaile ahile dukha lagnu sahi ho. kehi din ko lagi usko photo ra message dherai nahernus, ghaau baru chito niko hunchha. sathi ra parivar sanga samaya bitaunus, ani din ko euta sano kaam afno lagi garnus. bistarai, din haru halka hunchhan.
motivation chahiyo, 2 barsa dekhi loksewa ko tayari gardai chhu, pass bhaina
2 barsa nirantar lagnu nai thulo kura ho, dherai jana tyati samma pani tikdainan. pass nahunu le tapai ko mehanat bekar bhayo bhanne haina. pachhillo exam ma kun bhag ma ank gumyo, thaha chha?
written ma pugchha, interview ma fail hunchhu 2 palta

written 2 palta pass garnu bhayo bhane padhai ko samasya haina, bhanne tarika ko matra ho. tyo sikna sakinchha. sathi sanga mock interview garnus, afno jawaf phone ma record gari sunnus, ani pass bhayeka seniors lai sodhnus kasto prashna aauchha. 2 palta ko anubhav pani ahile tapai ko faida ho.
ma 14 barsa ko ho, coding sikna sakchhu?
pakkai sakchhau! 14 barsa coding suru garna ekdam ramro umer ho. kun kura banauna man chha, game, website ki app?
game

game man parchha bhane Scratch ki python bata suru gara. python ma 'pygame' bhanne library le sano 2D game banauna sakinchha. pahilo game ko lagi snake jasto sano game rojja, euta ek mahina ma banauna sakinchha. sakepachhi sathi lai khelauna dinu, tyo maja nai arko ho!
ek din ma 6 ghanta padhne plan banaye tara 1 ghanta matra padhe
plan thulo bhayo, tyo dherai jana ko galti ho, afu lai dosh nadinus. 1 ghanta padhnu pani shunya bhanda dherai ramro ho. bholi 2 ghanta ko plan banaunus.
2 ghanta ta dherai kam bhayena ra?

suru ma kam lagla, tara 2 ghanta pakka pura garda 'ma sakchhu' bhanne bharosa banchha. hapta bhari 2 ghanta pura bhayepachhi 3 ghanta banaunus. 6 ghanta plan garera 1 ghanta padhnu bhanda 2 ghanta pakka padhnu dobbar ho.
